<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/runtime`, touching **49** documentable anchor(s).

**33** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ea6de745cce19d0de551e938a6fc6bbe975dd35e`.

⛔ **11** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** cross-cutting symbol(s) contributed no route anchor: `resolveExecCtx (35 routes)`
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **44** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ea6de745cce19d0de551e938a6fc6bbe975dd35e` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `0f090d30dc70b8993073f73ae4c7f3eceb2ac3f2` — the merge of head `69f4887137d0a16819e4df05e067e23087ed6fc0` into base `ea6de745cce19d0de551e938a6fc6bbe975dd35e`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 0f090d30dc70b8993073f73ae4c7f3eceb2ac3f2 && git checkout 0f090d30dc70b8993073f73ae4c7f3eceb2ac3f2
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin ea6de745cce19d0de551e938a6fc6bbe975dd35e 69f4887137d0a16819e4df05e067e23087ed6fc0 && git checkout -B drift-repro ea6de745cce19d0de551e938a6fc6bbe975dd35e && git merge --no-ff 69f4887137d0a16819e4df05e067e23087ed6fc0

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ea6de745cce19d0de551e938a6fc6bbe975dd35e
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs ea6de745cce19d0de551e938a6fc6bbe975dd35e` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4c28847889579aa505b2d0b9d5a4e032da042307`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-exact-qualifier.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts, packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts + read, not reviewed: packages/objectql/src/registry.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts, protocol-lock-version-gates.ts, protocol-environment-rows.ts, packages/rest/src/import-mapping.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-routes.ts, ADR-0150 D3 to D5, ruling 6882483833

### ① Derived judgments

- Bare and execution read of a package-less row whose key only disabled packages hold: 200 to the withheld item (404). Right: `packagelessRowWithheldHolder` asks the registry's owner rule over every holder, and `null` (no holder at the key) stays served.
- `/meta/:type/_env/:name` for a name only disabled packages hold: 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` to 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, REST and runtime, naming no package. Right for the active read; not for the draft reads (S1).
- Protocol `admitEnvironmentQualifier`: still 409, now marked by a registered symbol. No export or signature moves. Every `_env` consumer must read the mark; one does not (S2).
- File surface: 8 files. `protocol.ts`, `protocol-save.ts` and `registry-question.ts` are untouched; `registry.ts` is read only.
- The rejection pins assert status and code together on both transports, and that no body names the disabled package. The ablation counts match the pins as written: 7 for the #33401 arm, 18 x 2 + 14 = 50 for the mark, 4 for the door's withheld check.
- Check-runs when read: 22 success, 16 skipped, 0 failed, 11 in progress (Test Core 1/8 to 8/8, Build Core, Type Check workspace, Type Check consumer gates). This record holds no verdict for those 11.

### ② Semver level

- `patch` on metadata-protocol, rest and runtime with `Metadata-protocol: none`: right. objectql is test-only.
- Kit: `!` in the title and the changeset summary, present. **BREAKING** banner in both, present. ADR-0087 marker, exactly one. Dogfood battery full and green, pinned to `00d7daf5`; this head differs from it by one changeset line (N1). `Skills-docs:` line absent (S3).
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` holds only if S1 closes in code. If the draft cell stays, the diff also widens, and that line and "No answer widens" are wrong.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Clause-② moved from the claim's `no`: accepted in kind, subject to S1.
- The objectql test file extension: the approval is the dev's word, on neither card. Accepted; #32849 edits it and the face file too, so the later lander merges.
- Ten commits, one merge of `main`, one extra bare read on the disabled-only path: accepted.
- Full suites last ran at 6665c856: the in-progress Test Core shards answer that.
- Ablations predate the `findOne` revert: accepted; the CONTROL asserts the bare read serves the row first.
- Out-of-scope action-envelope finding (same on `main`): escalated to the seat. #33401's acceptance names that CONTROL, so a card must exist before `Fixes #33401` closes it (N2).
- 14 of 18 types answer 404 in the stored-row fixture: accepted as behaviour (N3).
- `open_questions`: none.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing makes a declared refusal real. ADR-0150 D3: a disabled package holds no name. D4 and R15: a package-less row over a package-held name is that holder's customization. Ruling 6882483833: withhold it, serve the environment's own item. Nothing declared is taken at the consumer; the row is kept and returns on re-enable. Probes, read in the tree:

- Environment's own item: admitted before the mark, and the face's arm answers `null`. Holds.
- Both holders disabled: binding `undefined`, then `disabledOnlyHolderOf`, withheld; `_env` marked, 404. Holds.
- One of two disabled: the 409 is unmarked and names only the enabled holder. Unchanged.
- Package-less caller: the bare read is that caller; both faces pinned. Holds.

S1 (should-fix) — the `_env` door judges with the active read, then admits a draft read. `admitEnvironmentAddress` (both doors) calls `getMetaItem` with type, name and member only; the admitted read keeps `?state=draft` and `?preview=draft`. Read, not run: X is the only registry holder and disabled, and enabled package Y holds only a draft row of the name. `strictDraftReadAddress` answers Y (`packagelessAddress` counts rows alone), the item is stamped Y, and no arm of the face withholds it. `main` answers 409; this head answers 200 with Y's draft at the environment's address, the case the door's own comment says stays refused. Undeclared, unpinned, a widening. Fix: carry state and preview into the judging read, or refuse a marked draft read; pin both transports.

S2 (should-fix) — a third `_env` door keeps the old answer. `packages/rest/src/import-mapping.ts#namedMappingRead` calls `admitEnvironmentQualifier` for `mappingName: "_env/NAME"`, and its docblock promises the answer of `GET /meta/mapping/_env/NAME`. It does not read the mark: the import door still answers 409 naming the disabled package where `/meta` now answers 404. Fix: admit there the same way, or file the card and name the open door in the changeset.

S3 (should-fix) — `Skills-docs:` is missing from the PR body and the changeset; a `(narrowing)` owes it (`content/docs/data-modeling/import-mappings.mdx` documents the `_env` 409).

N1 (nit) — the battery pin names `00d7daf5`, not this head; accepted deviation.
N2 (nit) — the action CONTROL of #33401 is unpinned; follow-up card owed by the seat.
N3 (nit) — the stored-row 409 CONTROL is live on 4 types only.

No must-fix.

Head-sha: `4c28847889579aa505b2d0b9d5a4e032da042307`
Reviewer: review-c (areas S5 + S6) · read 2026-11-15T15:52Z
Implemented-by: `claude/area-E1b-33385` (S5 session_01QsR2jUcj2x2Wr4UErwBi12) · Reviewed-by: session_01QsR2jRMKz5NhWVrE4E1U5x
Contract-review record at this head: the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` comment directly above (narrowing face; isolated sub-agent; adopted). It has no must-fix and three open should-fix items, which the queue guard reads as open, so a delta review is owed. I confirmed S1's mechanism in the diff: both new `admitEnvironmentAddress` helpers call `getMetaItem` with `{ type, name, member }` only.

The design is accepted. The narrowing makes ADR-0150's declared refusal real (D3, D4/R15, seat ruling 6882483833) and takes no capability away: the row is kept and comes back on re-enable. REST and the runtime agree on 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`. The rejection pins assert both status and code, and the ablation counts match the pins. The file surface stays clear of `protocol.ts`, `protocol-save.ts` and `registry-question.ts`. The kit is complete except for S3: `!`, the BREAKING banner, one ADR-0087 marker, and the full dogfood battery.

1. **S1 (should-fix): the `_env` door judges the active read but admits a draft read.**
   - `admitEnvironmentAddress` (REST and runtime) asks `getMetaItem` without the request's `state=draft` / `preview=draft`.
   - Case: X is the only registry holder and is disabled, and an enabled package Y holds only a draft row of the name. Main answers 409 and this head answers 200 with Y's draft at the environment's address.
   - That is an undeclared, unpinned widening, which also makes "No answer widens" false.
   - Fix: pass the draft selector into the withheld check, and pin that case.
2. **S2 (should-fix): a third `_env` door keeps the old answer.** `packages/rest/src/import-mapping.ts` `namedMappingRead` calls `admitEnvironmentQualifier` for `mappingName: "_env/NAME"` and never reads the new mark. It still answers 409 naming the disabled package, while `/meta/mapping/_env/NAME` now answers 404. Its docblock promises the two give the same answer. Route it through the same check and pin it.
3. **S3 (should-fix): the `Skills-docs:` line is missing** from the PR body. review-checklist requires it on any `(narrowing)`.
4. **Nits.**
   - N1: the dogfood pin is at `00d7daf5`, one changeset line away from this head, so the code is covered.
   - N2 (follow-up owed): #33401's same-name-action-on-another-object CONTROL is unreachable because of an envelope defect in `protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`, which is the same on main. File it and name it on #33401 before `Fixes #33401` closes the card.
   - N3: the stored-row 409 CONTROL is live on 4 of 18 types only.
5. **Gates not judged.** At review time 22 checks succeeded, 16 were skipped and 11 were in progress (Test Core ×8, Build Core, Type Check ×2), with none red.

The delta review on the next head will cover S1–S3 plus any code that moves.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d86adb40b2c7fc53143d830ed9f2dcfdb33aa117`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .changeset/33385-disabled-holders-env-404.md, content/docs/data-modeling/import-mappings.mdx, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-exact-qualifier.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts, packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts, packages/rest/src/import-integration.test.ts, packages/rest/src/import-mapping.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.ts, packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts + read, not reviewed: packages/objectql/src/registry.ts (`overlaySlotBinding`, `overlayRowBinding`, `packageScopedHoldersOf`), packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-list-reads.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-environment-rows.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-overlay-merge.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-routes.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts, packages/rest/src/import-prepare.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-loader.ts, docs/adr/0150 (D3, D4, D5, R15), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch (SKILL.md, references/review-checklist.md), card #33401 and its ruling 6882483833

Read at 2026-11-15T21:18Z. First review of this head by this seat, taken on patrol as owed; claim: comment 6901345156; prior record 6897163317 is on an earlier head. Independence: implemented in a zhuangjianguo lane (domain:server#5); neither dispatched nor implemented by os-tesla.

### ① Derived judgments

Doors that read a name at the environment layer, each read in the tree at this head:

- `GET /meta/:type/_env/:name`, REST (`meta-qualified-item-route.ts`) and runtime (`domains/meta.ts`): a name only disabled packages hold moves from 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming them to 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` naming no package, on the plain read. Holds. The protocol still refuses (409, now marked); each door admits the marked refusal only when the read naming no package returns no item, and keeps the 409 when that read serves an item or throws. Pinned for all 18 `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` on both transports, each with the re-enable CONTROL.
- Same door with an admitted `?state=draft`, `?preview=draft`, or `?layers=`: the marked 409 stands, as on `main`. A caller the draft switches do not admit is answered the plain read, so it is judged and gets the 404. The REST door's `readsAsJudged` matches the item read's own parse of the three switches (`meta-item-read-routes.ts`, case-insensitive, `mayReadPendingDrafts` on the same resolved caller); the runtime door passes the already-admitted switches. Pinned on both transports for 18 types.
- Import door, `mappingName: "_env/NAME"` (`import-mapping.ts`): the same admission, answering 404 `MAPPING_NOT_FOUND`; re-enabled, 409 naming the holder. Pinned with the `/meta` answer beside it and no row written. `admitEnvironmentQualifier` has exactly three callers in `packages/**` and all three now read the mark.
- Read naming no package, served and execution faces (`readMetaItemFace`): a package-less item whose key only disabled packages hold is withheld (`packagelessRowWithheldHolder`). `null` binding (no holder at the key) stays served; one enabled holder stays served; two registry holders with one enabled fall to `disabledOnlyHolderOf` and stay served. Pinned in four orders on both faces, stored and hydrated, with re-enable.
- `/layers` (bare): the layered chain's owner step asks the plain read at the same member, so it follows the face. Pinned for a registry row at the canonical member on both transports; not pinned for a stored row at a member the holder never shipped (N2).
- Email send naming no package (`template-loader.ts`): untouched; a name with no served holder beside a disabled one already reads no list and sends nothing. Consistent with the 404.
- Unscoped list and execution list (`getMetaItems`, `getMetaItemsForExecution`): untouched by this diff and not pinned for this cell. See S1.
- Save and delete doors: untouched. No `_env` write door exists on `/meta` (the qualified address is GET only on both transports). See S3.
- Still served, by reading: a name an enabled package holds (unmarked 409 at `_env`, row served bare); the environment's own item; a name with a disabled and an enabled registry holder. The suites that pin the mixed-holder cells on `main` are green at this head (CI below).

Prior record 6897163317 and the seat review 6897171983, by id:

- S1 (draft read admitted on the active read's judgment, a widening): closed in code by refusing the marked refusal for any read that is not the plain read. No widening remains that I can read.
- S2 (import door kept the old 409): closed, with pin, CONTROL and the docs page.
- S3 (`Skills-docs:` line): half closed. The changeset carries it and it is true as far as `skills/**` goes. The PR body still does not (S2 below).
- N1 (battery not pinned to the head): open and wider now (S2 below).
- N2 (the action CONTROL of #33401): tracked on #33904 per card comment 6897182220; not re-verified here.
- N3 (stored-row 409 CONTROL live on 4 of 18 types): stands.

### ② Semver level

- `patch` on metadata-protocol, rest and runtime with `Metadata-protocol: none`: right. No authorable key or value moves; objectql is test-only; `protocol.ts` is untouched and no export or declared signature moves.
- Changeset kit: `!` in the summary, **BREAKING** banner, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, exactly one ADR-0087 marker (`not-required (no-migration-prescription)`), FROM and TO for the bare read, `_env` and the import door, the three cases that keep 409, the remedy (re-enable the package), `Skills-docs:` line. Complete for what it covers.
- PR body: both declaration lines, the `!` title and the banner are present. Everything else in it describes head `4c288478`: see S2.
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` now holds: with prior S1 closed, no answer I can read widens.
- CI at this head, 53 check-runs: 36 success, 15 skipped, 2 failure, none running. The failures are `Test Core (3/8)` and the `Test Core` aggregate. The red task is `@objectstack/scenarios#test`: `test/runner/run-date.test.ts` timed out at 5000ms on one run date, in a package this diff does not touch; in the same shard `@objectstack/runtime` passed 605 files. By reading it is not this diff's, but that is a reading, not a re-run. This record PASSES the contract with that check red, and holds no verdict for it: it must be re-run green before the queue.

### ③ Boundary flags

- File surface grew from the claimed 8 to 12: `import-mapping.ts`, `import-integration.test.ts`, `rest-server.ts` (the host literal, 4 lines) and the docs page, all in answer to the prior review. No extension is recorded on either card and no dev report exists for the six commits after `4c288478`.
- The other `_env` families (`/automation/_env/:name`, `/actions/_env/:object/:action`) resolve through their own code, not `admitEnvironmentQualifier`. Read as out of both cards' scope; their answer for a name only disabled packages hold is not judged here.
- The mark is a `Symbol.for` key spelled as a string in four files with no shared export. An embedder's own door calling the published `admitEnvironmentQualifier` keeps the 409 unless it knows the key. Accepted under the claim's `protocol.ts` exclusion; see N4.
- "A disabled package holds no name (ADR-0150 D3)": the ADR text on this ref carries no sentence about disabled packages. The rule is the epic's (#32183 row 17, R4-B2) and the seat's (6882483833 on #32814). The changeset cites the ADR for it, as earlier changesets in this epic do. Not this PR's to fix.
- The action CONTROL named by #33401's acceptance is unpinned here and tracked on #33904 (prior N2).

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing makes a ruled refusal real and takes no stored capability away: the row is kept and returns on re-enable, which the pins assert. ADR-0150 D4 and R15 make a package-less row over a package-held name that holder's customization; ruling 6882483833 counts every holder, disabled included, and puts the member outside the key. The face's new arm reads the registry's one owner rule over every holder, which is that ruling. The `_env` design (refuse in the synchronous protocol method, mark, let the door ask the asynchronous read) is sound, and the door's second read is the same request the admitted read then makes.

S1 (should-fix) — the lists are a sibling door this diff neither moves, pins nor declares. Read, not run: the unscoped list's disabled-holder filter (`protocol-meta-list-reads.ts`, the `disabledHolderListing` call) keeps every item bound to no package, and a stored package-less row at a member no enabled package ships seats a slot of its own in the merge. So with the only holder disabled, `GET /meta/:type` and the execution list would still carry the row whose by-name read now answers 404. Before this diff both served it; after it they disagree, against the list's own stated rule that the list and the by-name read hide the same items, and against the PR body's sentence that a disabled package's customization is never served. The sibling fix for the pair's row (#32354) pinned list and send beside the by-name read; this one pins neither. Fix: measure it on the #33401 fixture; then move the lists, or file the card and name the open door in the changeset and PR body.

S2 (should-fix) — the PR body and the verification kit describe an earlier head. The body has no `Skills-docs:` line (owed on a `(narrowing)`), no row for the import door, and states the `_env` cell without the three reads that keep 409. Its builds, 73 gates, ablations and dogfood battery are pinned to `00d7daf5`; four later commits change door code in rest and runtime, and none of the new arms (the draft-switch judgment, the import door's admission) carries an ablation. The seat's checklist asks for the battery at the head. All of this closes without moving the head, except new ablation evidence if the lane chooses to add pins.

S3 (should-fix) — the write side is not declared. The changeset says what happens to an existing row. It does not say what a save or delete at such a name does while every holder is disabled. Read, not run: the save door has no disabled-holder judgment for these types, so a package-less save is accepted and its read-back answers 404. That already held on `main` at a member the holder ships; this diff extends it to members it does not. Fix: one changeset sentence saying a save is kept and hidden until re-enable (or measure and correct me), and a pin.

S4 (should-fix) — the residual `_env` 409 names the disabled package. With an admitted draft switch or `?layers=`, and whenever the judging read serves or refuses, the answer is the marked refusal, whose only candidate is the disabled holder; the enabled package that actually holds the name through its stored row is not named.
